title: Small fan, maybe slightly cooling
text: Small fan, maybe slightly cooling. I read all the reviews, so I knew it was probably crap.  But I know it is not an air conditioner, and I didn't expect it to cool a room, even my very small bathroom.  I just wanted something small that I can stand right in front of while I am doing my hair.  My bathroom just gets warm, and then when you add heat from blow dryers and curling wands - it's no fun.  I tried it, and followed all the directions.  I soaked the filter and froze it overnight and I used ice water with ice cubes in it.  I am pretty sure it is still putting our air that is just room temp - so no better than a fan.  I might still return it and just get a small fan for that spot.  It is a pain to do all that freezing etc for no reason...Mine did work, however, and hasn't started leaking yet.  Maybe I had better send it back now before it's too late!

product_metadata.title: Arctic Air Pure Chill 2.0 Evaporative Air Cooler by Ontel - Powerful, Quiet, Lightweight and Portable Space Cooler with Hydro-Chill Technology For Bedroom, Office, Living Room & More
features: Personal Air Cooler for Indoor & Outdoor Spaces: Switch to an eco-friendly solution with Ontel Arctic Air Pure Chill 2.0. Featuring Hydro-Chill Technology and cooling control with dual cooling jets, it helps cool and humidify the air around you.

Space-Saving Portable Design: The compact, sleek design allows you to place the box cooler on your office desk, nightstand, coffee table, or kitchen counter. It is lightweight, so you can easily carry it around the house or while travelling.

Energy Efficient Cooling Device: The Arctic Air Pure Chill cooler operates on 8-10 watts of power to minimize energy consumption. The multi-directional air vents allow you to adjust the direction of airflow, making it perfect for any room or office.

Easy to Use Cooler: Pour water in the top-fill tank, plug it in and enjoy refreshing cooler air all night long. Runs for up to 10 hours* so you don’t have to worry about frequent refilling. *Depending on speed setting, room temperature & humidity levels.

Convenient Controls - The personal air cooling unit is equipped with easy-to-use touch controls to switch between the 4 speed settings, and built-in LED nightlight with 7 fun color options - everything you need to operate your cooler, in one place
description: ARCTIC AIR PURE CHILL 2.0 - Evaporative Air Cooler Take your cooling comfort wherever you go with the Ontel Arctic Air Pure Chill 2.0 - a compact evaporative air-cooler that fits into any corner of your room and disperses gentle, refreshing air all day, every day. With Hydro-Chill Technology, cooling control with dual cooling jets and premium evaporative cooling cartridge, the small personal cooler turns hot, dry air into a cool breeze, giving you the finest air quality and desirable ventilation. Simply fill the quick and easy top-fill water tank that prevents water spills and enjoy cooling air flow for up to 10 hours (run-time depends on speed setting, room temperature and humidity levels). Featuring multi-directional air vents, in-built LED night light with 7 fun color options, 4-speed settings low, medium, high and turbo, and simple touch controls, the mini cooler is the perfect air cooling system for your nightstand, work desk, coffee table or kitchen counter. With whisper-quiet operation, the cooler makes minimal noise so that you can get a peaceful night’s sleep without any disturbances. This air-cooler and humidifier is lightweight and easy-to-carry, and a user-friendly choice for travelling.
